notes.title: New 20 Tracks in Major Update
notes.content: [p][b]Iso Racer Adds 20 New Tracks in Major Update[/b][/p][p]We released a major content update for [i]Iso Racer[/i], adding 20 brand-new tracks to the fast-paced isometric racing game. Available now on Racing Fest 2025, this update significantly expands the game’s track roster and introduces a wide range of environments—from the desert city of Qatar to the tight corners of Mexico![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43962574/86bf4e06405f74a17d65167c11b6ace5e06cb414.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Each track offers unique challenges designed to test players’ reflexes and racing strategy. Some emphasize tight corners and drifting, while others focus on acceleration, top speed, or navigating tricky hazards. The update aims to increase variety and replayability, while giving players more reason to compete for leaderboard domination.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43962574/a76e3945b1dd9c8d0e4dfedd3a28ffb717fabb11.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Alongside the new tracks, players can enjoy enhanced visuals, improved handling mechanics.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43962574/18545ac6d94b3127ecf4a6c14ead1bacd76276be.jpg"][/img][/p][p]With this update, [i]Iso Racer[/i] continues to build on its momentum as one of the most exciting minimalist racing games on the market.[/p][p][/p][p]See you on the track![/p]

notes.title: Update 0.5.7.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43962574/840446d88f3f92dc1e76ea835ac5245ec9ef5b3c.png[/img]

[b]In version 0.5.7.1:[/b]

- fixed bugs with vehicle level setting in busted mode

- visual bugs in the garage have been fixed

- drift points work correctly for people joining the lobby

- visual improvement of wheel rotation for those who join the lobby

- visual improvement of tire tracks and smoke for those who join the lobby

- improved performance when drawing new checkpoints in busted mode

- race ending bug fixed

The current provided changelog reflects the major changes within the game as part of this Update. Some updates, additions and fixes may not be listed in the provided notes.

notes.title: NEW LOBBY SYSTEM & ARCADE MODE
notes.content:
[b]Finally! [/b]Due to the fact that the last model of automatic lobby creation and player joining within 20 seconds turned out to be mediocre in practice, we have completely redesigned the lobby to give players a wider range of options when hosting a lobby and the ability to create their own private lobbies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43962574/f9e57aa2a01085eef1e2cdceaaa6153e063dfe33.png[/img]

Currently, players have the following functions available when creating a lobby:

[list]
[*] Set a password for the room

[*] Choose the game mode to be applied in the lobby: Basic / Drift (old standard) / Busted

[*] Choose vehicle classes in any configuration: A B C D E

[*] Choose the difficulty level of bots: EASY / MEDIUM / HARD (beta)
[/list]
Additionally, we have added a new mode that is more accessible to new players, and the basic mode that was before the update is now called drift.

[b]We invite everyone to test out the new features and provide feedback on our Discord![/b]
https://discord.gg/dQCnZGhVH3

After implementing all necessary corrections to the current system, we will focus on adding content.

notes.title: BUSTED mode for Iso Racer is out now!
notes.content:
We know you've been waiting a long time, but [b]it's finally here[/b]. 
New game mode [b]BUSTED[/b] for Iso Racer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43962574/e024a3171b96cd19d00f305cb68343d9fc987279.png[/img]

Sit behind the wheel of one of the police cars and keep order in the city.
[b]But be careful![/b] The runner has at his disposal all the vehicles that he has managed to purchase and upgrade in the classic mode so far.

[b]A large open city is placed in your hands.[/b]
The escaping player's task is to capture as many checkpoints as possible, randomly generated on the map.
The police, in turn, have the task of stopping the escapee, preferably by completely damaging his vehicle.
Have fun :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43962574/432d4bfdb343b66fd8aed17c96efc3570ec9a10e.png[/img]

We are also testing a new lobby mode and if it works fine, we will introduce a similar one to classic races.

notes.title: New Content Coming Soon
notes.content:
We present you with graphics announcing the [b]upcoming major update. [/b]
We don't want to give you too much away, but there is a lot to look forward to.

We are working all the time on a new network mode, which we will also want to introduce to the classic racing mode. 
We want to give players more freedom to create and join lobbies. As well as give you the ability to determine what classes of cars you want to allow in your lobbies and many other improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43962574/e5ef69b516f5dffd71ccd0c8e31ece52c0d18cf8.png[/img]

We are glad that you like the recent improvements, so we are working on more all the time.

More information on the new mode and upcoming improvements [b]coming soon![/b]

notes.title: PASSIVE EARNING vehicles NOW available!
notes.content:
I'm glad that we can finally bring you the long-announced update, with[b] special vehicles that additionally have the ability to send them to earn money.[/b]  

Of course, you can also sit behind the wheel of these vehicles. Each is distinguished by its own characteristics. We encourage you to play alone or with friends Articulated Bus, Monstertruck, Ramp Car, Tank and Combat Helicopter. (The latter two I do not wish you to meet on your way!!!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43962574/14a16dcdf3651a593a9c39d85acf74cdda34bff4.png[/img]

After buying these vehicles, you have the option of sending them to work in the garage. Each of them, after 20 hours, will benefit you in the form of cash to your account. The higher the category, the more money it earns.


In addition, [b]we added the option to enable the camera ahead of the vehicle[/b]. From now on, those who are not yet familiar with the routes will be able to see the turns earlier.

An additional [b]option to include in the options, is a green arrow pointing to the correct checkpoint[/b] (for those who do not have divided attention enough to follow this information on the minimap)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43962574/08561dd2bbcff51972180c3f32039b6d87da6f08.png[/img]

We are currently planning to fix some bugs. 

Also, announcements of BUSTED mode will be coming soon!

notes.title: Iso Racer is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Good day to you, future racers!

For us all, today is a special day.

The day that heralds the launch of Iso Racer on Steam Early Access!

A day when you can get behind the wheel of your favorite car.

The day we embark on a new exciting adventure, together with you.

So may it be a great day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43962574/28d5fa7ddddf4b469169207bbf75f724b33dca61.png[/img]

We lack proper words to describe how thrilled we are to finally deliver Iso Racer into your hands. Thanks to Early Access, none of us should have to wait for it anymore. But it also means we have a long road ahead of us, and we trust you'll help us get there. Iso Racer already has a solid experience to offer, but in order for it to really shine, we intend to improve it significantly in the coming months. And while we have no shortage of ideas on how to turn our game into a gem in the final version, we believe that the really right concepts are those that resonate with our fans - with you! So we invite you to join us in this ambitious and passionate endeavor to bring Iso Racer to its full size and splendor! The road to ultimate success may be slippery - just like in the game - but the initial recipe should be quite simple. Just slowly cut corners. Grab the game now and make sure your voice is heard - share with us all your thoughts, ideas and suggestions as they come to mind while playing Iso Racer.

Greetings
Pogo

notes.title: Gamepad support!
notes.content:
We have introduced support for the most popular gamepads! 
In the Iso Racer, you can now use a gamepad controller to control your race car and perform various actions.
The gamepad controller provides a more immersive and enjoyable racing experience compared to using a keyboard or mouse.
In the near future, we plan to be able to operate the entire game via gamepad.
